name: Pika H3 Flex (open-weight video + audio model)
summary: Pika's post-trained adapter on MiniMax-H3 that generates video with synchronized stereo audio in six sampling steps. Local weights cover text-to-video, first/last-frame conditioning and multi-reference (up to 9 images, 3 videos, 3 audio clips) at native 480p/768p, 5-15 s, 24 fps. 1080p-4K, audio stems and prompt rewriting stay on Pika's paid API.

access.price: $0 for local weights; 1080p/2K/4K, stems and prompt rewriter via paid Pika API
access.notes: License excludes the EU, UK, US and South Korea (no use there without a separate MiniMax license). Commercial use must display 'MiniMax H3'; >$20M yearly revenue needs written authorization; acceptable-use policy applies.

procedure: Check the MiniMax H3 Community License covers your country (EU/UK/US/KR are excluded).
Follow the Install quickstart in the GitHub repo; the package pulls the pinned MiniMax-H3 base and the Pika adapter from Hugging Face.
Run a task (t2va, i2va, l2va, fl2va or ref2va) via the CLI or the bundled ComfyUI nodes.

verdict.why: Major-lab open-weight video+audio model, not gated, documented modes and specs. Big caveats: ~220 GB and H100-class hardware, top resolutions API-only, and the base license excludes EU/UK/US/KR.
